Only one API-layer handler function directly calls `Store.CreateMemo`:

APIV1Service.CreateMemo — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go

(This handler calls `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:115`, where `Store.CreateMemo` is defined in `store/memo.go:109`. Note: `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56` also invokes `s.CreateMemo` (the API handler itself, to create a comment memo), but that is a call to the API-layer handler, not a direct call to `Store.CreateMemo`. Similarly, `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:307` just delegates to `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` rather than calling the store directly.)
